new.story: A 1979 Italian 50 lire coin showing Vulcan, the Roman god of fire, hammering iron on his anvil. Italy used lire until switching to the euro in 2002.
new.notes: Blind double-read. L.50 / 979 (1979, leading 1 worn) read from enlargement. Vulcan design matches IT.KM.95.1.

source: NOID_Italy_1979_50Lire_obv.jpg (owner chat 2026-10-13); Numista N#724: 50 Lire, KM#95.1, 1954-1989
